summary: An on/off switch, like a light switch, used to turn a setting on or off.
description:
A simple toggle switch used to switch between two states (on/off), with an optional label and description.

**`MozToggle extends MozBaseInputElement`** and is tiny: it declares only `pressed`, sets `static activatedProperty = "pressed"`, and overrides `inputTemplate()` to render a single `<button>` carrying `name`, `value` and `accesskey`. Everything else in the tables below is inherited and rendered by the base class's wrapper around that template, which is why the attribute list is longer than the class itself.

attributes.name: pressed
attributes.description: Whether or not the element is pressed (on).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the element is disabled.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label text when there is no visible label.

attributes.name: ariaDescription
attributes.description: The aria-description text when there is no visible description.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner button.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the input control, rendered onto the internal <button>.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the input control, rendered onto the internal <button>.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to (attribute: support-page).

attributes.name: accessKey
attributes.description: Mapped accesskey attribute, applied to the internal <button>.

attributes.name: parentDisabled
attributes.description: Internal: set by a parent input/fieldset to cascade a disabled state.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Used to append a moz-support-link to the description.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Custom event (bubbles, composed) indicating that the toggle's pressed state has changed.
